items.work: Planar Orthogonal Polynomials as Type I Multiple Orthogonal Polynomials
items.difficulty_reason: H2整链：215-244、281-397、413-604将二维Gaussian-planar orthogonality转为一维contour-Laplace moment，再转constant-coefficient differential operator的Taylor消失条件，并构造kernel exponential-polynomial的稀疏Taylor projection以证明type-I interpolation存在且唯一；还保留作者Wirtinger/Fourier替代证明。研究难点为planar权与type-I multiple orthogonality的等价及kernel projection，而非单独Cauchy/Fubini技巧。
